description: This file defines the TaxRate class, which is an entity representing tax rate data, including properties such as tax priority, rate, associated class, country, zone, and hierarchical relationships. It is used within a shopping or sales management system to model tax rates applied to products or transactions.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Entity class representing a tax rate, including details such as rate, priority, geographic scope, related tax class, and hierarchical relationships for complex tax configurations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the tax rate.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the tax rate.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information for the entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the entity.

methods.name: getTaxPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority level of the tax rate.

methods.name: setTaxPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority level of the tax rate.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Returns the tax rate as a BigDecimal value.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Sets the tax rate value.

methods.name: isPiggyback
methods.description: Checks if the tax rate is piggybacked.

methods.name: setPiggyback
methods.description: Sets whether the tax rate is piggybacked.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves the tax class associated with this rate.

methods.name: setTaxClass
methods.description: Associates a tax class with this rate.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for this tax rate.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this tax rate.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Gets the merchant store associated with the tax rate.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the tax rate.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country where the tax rate applies.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country for the tax rate.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves the zone associated with the tax rate.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the zone for the tax rate.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Returns child tax rates linked hierarchically.

methods.name: setTaxRates
methods.description: Sets child tax rates.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Gets the parent tax rate if this is a sub-rate.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets a parent tax rate, establishing hierarchy.

methods.name: getStateProvince
methods.description: Returns the state or province for the tax rate.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the tax code string.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the tax code string.

methods.name: getRateText
methods.description: Returns additional textual representation of the rate.

methods.name: setRateText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the rate.
